“大家一起欢迎，楚枫师弟，鼓掌。”
“啪啪啪...”
楚月将楚枫带到后，一边高呼一边拍手。
见状，那几位非楚家的楚盟成员，也是跟着鼓掌欢迎，对楚枫点头示意。
楚枫昨日的实力他们见到了，不管楚家人怎么看楚枫，至少在他们心里已是认可了楚枫。
只不过，除了楚月等几人外，那些楚家子弟却没有任何表示，并且他们看向楚枫的目光极为不善。
“楚月，你搞没搞错，既然带这个外人加入我楚盟？赶紧让他滚。”楚威突然怒喝道。
“没错，我楚盟不欢迎他，让他快滚。”与此同时，其他人也是大声呼喊起来。
他们的声音很大， 似是故意让所有人听见一般，事实上，他们也的确引起了周围人的注意。
这一刻，楚枫眉头微皱，他无论如何也想不到，楚威他们会以这种形式欢迎他。
这哪里是欢迎，简直就是故意让他出丑，让他在诸多弟子的面前出丑。
“楚威大哥，你们干什么？昨日你不是说好...”这一刻，楚月急了，她有些不知所措。
“楚月你给我闭嘴，这楚盟我说的算，我楚盟可以收任何人入伙，但绝对不会收他楚枫。”楚威并没给楚月说完话的机会。
“楚威，想不到你...”
“好，你不收楚枫弟，那我也退出楚盟。”
楚月终于反应过来，她知道她是被楚威给利用了，利用她让楚枫如此难堪。
“楚月，这恐怕不是你说的算的，除非你要离开楚家，否则你就不能退出楚盟。”楚威冷笑，似乎早就猜到楚月会有这般反应。
“你...你简直....”楚月被气的咬牙切齿，可又不知如何是好，无奈之下只好将目光投向楚枫：“楚枫弟，我....”
“楚月姐，不用解释，我知道这件事不怪你。”楚枫面容很平静，他扫视一眼楚威等人淡淡的道：

“你们楚盟不收我楚枫对吧？好，很好，后悔。”
“哈哈哈，真是笑话，你还真以为你是什么大人物不成？我们后悔？你也值得让我们后悔？”
“就是，你以为你是什么东西，真是不要脸。”
然而根本没人把楚枫的话放在心上，在他们来看，楚枫不过就是一个废物，因为在很小的时候，他们心底就已经对楚枫印下了这样的标记。
“这里还真是热闹。”可就在这时，一道响亮的声音突然响起。
定目望去，只见两名少年，正在缓步而来。
这是一对双胞台兄弟，身上的紫色长袍非常之脏，脏到可以看到油汪汪的亮光。
尤其二人手中皆拿着一根甘蔗，咀嚼之时，不断发出刺耳的“吧唧”声，实在令人厌烦。
只不过，当人们看到这二人，胸口之上的勋章之后，却无一不是为之大惊。
那勋章之上，刻着一对翅膀，而这正是内门最强同盟的标志，翼盟。
“是翼盟成员，龙兄虎弟。”这一刻，许多人已是认出这二位，各种惊呼声响彻不断。
男弟子都流露出敬佩的神情，而女弟子更是尖叫连连，一副爱上了这两位的模样，就连楚月也是变得凝重起来。
“楚月姐，你认识他们？”楚枫好奇的问道。
“嗯，他们名为白龙和白虎，与我同龄，都是十六岁。”
“当年他们与我一同拜入青龙宗，却在十二岁通过内门考核，并且还是当时考核的第一名。”
“据说，他们一年前就已经迈入灵武六重，是真正的天才弟子。”
楚月说起这二人，神色非常凝重，可见这二人在楚月心中，的确留下了非常重的分量。
“十六岁，便是灵武六重！”
听楚月这样一说，楚枫也是重新打量起龙兄虎弟，要知道他大哥楚孤雨，十七岁迈入灵武六重，已被认为是天才。
而这两位居然比楚孤雨足足早了一年，由此可见，翼盟的成员果然是不容小窥，也难怪会被视为神话组织。

“龙...龙兄虎弟，他们似乎在向我们这走来，我..我们..没人招惹过他们吧？”
见龙兄虎弟的目标，竟然是这里，楚盟的所有人都变得紧张起来，就连那楚威也不例外。
毕竟这对兄弟的名头太响亮了，就算除去翼盟的身份，依然无法掩盖他们的光芒。
这样的人物，是他们不敢得罪的，因为如果得罪了他们，就形容于在内门被判了死刑。
不过当龙兄虎弟靠近后，众人却终于松了口气，因为他们发现，龙兄虎弟的目标竟然是楚枫。
“你叫楚枫？”白龙打量了着楚枫。
“有事？”楚枫从容的回道。
“喔？”见楚枫应下，那白虎的眉头不由微皱，也是开始打量起楚枫。
“太好了，原来龙兄虎弟真的是来找楚枫的。”
“哼，刚进入内门便得罪了龙兄虎弟，真是活该。”
“让他猖狂，看他这次是怎么死的。”
这一刻，楚家人心中皆是大喜，他们都恨不得楚枫得罪哪个大人物，然后被人抹杀。
只是想不到，楚枫这么快便得罪了龙兄虎弟，这实在让他们太过兴奋了。
只不过，当龙兄虎弟说出下一句话时，他们却瞬间傻眼了。
“楚枫，有兴趣加入翼盟么？”

"Everyone welcomes you, Junior Brother Chu Feng, and applauds."
"Pa bang bang..."
Chu Yue brought Chu Feng back, shouting and clapping her hands.
Seeing this, the few members of the Chu Alliance who were not from the Chu family also applauded and nodded to Chu Feng.
They saw Chu Feng's strength yesterday. No matter what the Chu family thought of Chu Feng, at least they recognized Chu Feng in their hearts.
However, except for Chu Yue and a few others, the Chu family disciples did not show any expression, and they looked at Chu Feng with extremely unkind eyes.
"Chu Yue, are you mistaken? Since you brought this outsider to join our Chu Alliance? Let him go quickly." Chu Wei suddenly shouted angrily.
"That's right, our Chu League doesn't welcome him, so let him get out of here." At the same time, others also shouted loudly.
Their voices were loud, as if they were deliberately being heard by everyone. In fact, they did attract the attention of those around them.
At this moment, Chu Feng frowned slightly. He never imagined that Chu Wei and the others would welcome him in this way.
This was not a welcome, it was simply a deliberate attempt to make him look embarrassed in front of many disciples.
"Brother Chu Wei, what are you doing? Didn't you agree yesterday..." At this moment, Chu Yue was anxious and at a loss.
"Chu Yue, shut up. I have the final say over this Chu League. I, the Chu League, can recruit anyone into the gang, but I will never recruit him, Chu Feng." Chu Wei did not give Chu Yue a chance to finish his words.
"Chu Wei, I didn't expect you..."
"Okay, if you don't accept Chu Feng's brother, then I will withdraw from the Chu Alliance."
Chu Yue finally realized that she knew that she was being used by Chu Wei, who used her to make Chu Feng so embarrassed.
"Chu Yue, I'm afraid this is not your decision. Unless you want to leave the Chu family, you cannot withdraw from the Chu Alliance." Chu Wei sneered, as if he had already guessed that Chu Yue would react like this.
"You...you are simply..." Chu Yue was so angry that she gritted her teeth, but she didn't know what to do. She had no choice but to turn her eyes to Chu Feng: "Brother Chu Feng, I..."
"Sister Chu Yue, there is no need to explain. I know that this matter is not your fault." Chu Feng's face was very calm. He glanced at Chu Wei and others and said calmly:
"Your Chu League won't accept me, Chu Feng, right? Okay, very good, I regret it."
"Hahaha, what a joke. Do you really think you are a big shot? Do we regret it? Are you worthy of making us regret it?"
"It's just, what do you think you are? You are so shameless."
However, no one took Chu Feng's words to heart at all. From their point of view, Chu Feng was just a waste, because when they were very young, they had already placed such a mark on Chu Feng in their hearts.
"It's really lively here." But at this moment, a loud voice suddenly sounded.
Looking closely, I saw two young men approaching slowly.
These are twin brothers. The purple robes on their bodies are very dirty, so dirty that you can see the oily shine.
In particular, both of them were holding a sugar cane in their hands. When they chewed it, they kept making harsh "chirping" sounds, which was really annoying.
However, when people saw the medals on the chests of these two people, they were all shocked.
On the medal, there is a pair of wings engraved on it, and this is the symbol of the strongest alliance in the inner sect, the Wing Alliance.
"They are members of the Wing Alliance, brothers dragon and tiger." At this moment, many people recognized these two people, and various exclamations resounded.
The male disciples all showed expressions of admiration, while the female disciples screamed repeatedly, as if they were in love with these two people, and even Chu Yue became solemn.
"Sister Chu Yue, do you know them?" Chu Feng asked curiously.
"Well, their names are White Dragon and White Tiger. They are the same age as me. They are both sixteen years old."
"They were with me back thenHe joined the Qinglong Sect, but passed the inner sect examination at the age of twelve, and was the first in the examination at that time. "
“It is said that they entered the sixth level of Lingwu a year ago and are truly genius disciples. "
When Chu Yue talked about these two people, her expression was very solemn, which showed that these two people indeed left a very heavy weight in Chu Yue's heart.
“At the age of sixteen, he is the sixth level of Lingwu! "
Hearing what Chu Yue said, Chu Feng also looked at Brother Long and Brother Tiger again. You must know that his eldest brother Chu Guyu entered the sixth level of Lingwu at the age of seventeen and was already considered a genius.
These two people were actually a full year earlier than Chu Guyu. From this, it can be seen that the members of the Wing Alliance are indeed not to be underestimated. It is no wonder that they are regarded as a mythical organization.
"Dragon...Dragon brothers and tiger brothers, they seem to be coming towards us. I...we...none of us have provoked them, right?" "
Seeing that the target of Brother Long and Brother Tiger was actually here, everyone in the Chu League became nervous, even Chu Wei.
After all, the names of these two brothers are so resounding that even if they remove their identity as the Wing Alliance, they still can't cover up their light.
They dare not offend such a person, because if they offend them, they will be sentenced to death in the inner sect.
However, when the Dragon Brother and the Tiger Brother approached, everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief, because they discovered that the target of the Dragon Brother and the Tiger Brother was actually Chu Feng.
"Your name is Chu Feng? "Bai Long looked at Chu Feng.
"Something's wrong? "Chu Feng replied calmly.
"Oh? "Seeing Chu Feng's response, the white tiger couldn't help but frown slightly, and began to look at Chu Feng.
"Great, it turns out that Brother Long and Brother Tiger really came to see Chu Feng. "
"Hmph, I offended the dragon brother and the tiger brother as soon as I entered the inner gate. I really deserve it. "
"Let him be rampant and see how he dies this time. "
At this moment, the Chu family members were all overjoyed. They all wished that Chu Feng would offend some big shot and then be wiped out.
They just didn't expect that Chu Feng would offend Brother Long and Brother Tiger so quickly, which really made them too excited.
However, when the dragon brother and the tiger brother said the next sentence, they were instantly dumbfounded.
"Chu Feng, are you interested in joining the Wing Alliance? "
